"""SQLite persistence for users."""

import sqlite3

_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
])
_conn.commit()


def _to_dict(row):
    return dict(row) if row else None


def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())


def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+# Root of the project's data directory; request paths are resolved relative to it.
+_DATA_DIR = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data").resolve()
+
+_BAD_SEGMENTS = frozenset({"", ".", ".."})
+
+
+def _valid_segments(raw: str) -> list[str] | None:
+    """Return the segments of a data-relative path, or None when it is unsafe."""
+    segments = raw.split("/")
+    if any(segment in _BAD_SEGMENTS for segment in segments):
+        return None
+    return segments
+
+
+def handle_line_count(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    """Count the lines of a file inside the project's data directory."""
+    raw = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    segments = _valid_segments(raw)
+    if segments is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+
+    target = _DATA_DIR.joinpath(*segments).resolve()
+    if not target.is_relative_to(_DATA_DIR) or not target.is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    lines = text.count("\n")
+    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
+        lines += 1
+    return 200, {"lines": lines}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+# Root of the project's data directory; request paths are resolved relative to it.
+_DATA_DIR = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data").resolve()
+
+_BAD_SEGMENTS = frozenset({"", ".", ".."})
+
+
+def _valid_segments(raw: str) -> list[str] | None:
+    """Return the segments of a data-relative path, or None when it is unsafe."""
+    segments = raw.split("/")
+    if any(segment in _BAD_SEGMENTS for segment in segments):
+        return None
+    return segments
+
+
+def handle_line_count(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    """Count the lines of a file inside the project's data directory."""
+    raw = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    segments = _valid_segments(raw)
+    if segments is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+
+    target = _DATA_DIR.joinpath(*segments).resolve()
+    if not target.is_relative_to(_DATA_DIR) or not target.is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    lines = text.count("\n")
+    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
+        lines += 1
+    return 200, {"lines": lines}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
